summary: Castellum, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, announcing its CEO will present at the Maxim Group Defense Tech and Domestic Supply Chain Virtual Conference on June 25, 2026, and that a subsidiary won a $4 million U.S. Navy ADMACS Modernization Subcontract. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is disclosed. This is a routine current report of normal business activities and conference participation, not a special situation.
